federation_invalid_request: The federation request is invalid or its login state is missing, expired, or replayed. Restart sign-in and complete it in one browser session.
federation_provider_not_found: The requested identity provider does not exist. Refresh the provider list and choose an existing provider.
federation_provider_issuer_exists: An identity provider for this issuer already exists in the tenant. Choose a different issuer or update the existing provider.
federation_provider_role_missing: The provider default role does not exist in this tenant. Choose a role that exists or clear the default role.
federation_provider_disabled: This identity provider is disabled. An administrator must enable it before you can sign in with it.
federation_provisioning_disabled: This identity provider cannot provision new accounts. An administrator must create your account and link it to the identity provider first.
federation_identity_unavailable: The linked account or its tenant membership is disabled. Contact an administrator to restore access.
federation_email_unverified: Automatic account provisioning requires a verified email address from the identity provider. Ask an administrator to check the provider claims or provision the account manually.
federation_oidc_failed: The identity provider rejected or could not complete the sign-in. Restart sign-in and try again; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
federation_unavailable: The federation service could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
